inventory.source: HotSpawn lobby open fixtures as strictly normalized by f7279a54
inventory.policy: include lobby-listed open fixtures; exclude API-only/cancelled/started status conflicts
inventory.hotspawn_probability_policy: never use crowd pick ownership as a probability, prior, feature, or tiebreak

ladder: current HLTV research probe for featured gaps

flags.title: Official VRS is outside the 14-day preferred window
flags.detail: Valve's latest global file at capture was 2026_10_05 (25.63 days old). Model rows are labelled, not presented as sportsbook lines.

flags.title: One exact-fixture market required a narrow ex- roster alias
flags.detail: Bovada and Melbet both omitted HotSpawn's ex- prefix for ex-CYBERSHOKE; exact BlinkDagger opponent and exact kickoff were required.

flags.title: Duplicate official VRS team names handled without name-only joins
flags.detail: Banda Chuya is selected only where current bo3.gg rank equals an official row; The Huns publishes the conservative edge shared by both official rows.

flags.title: Two fixtures use one-sided VRS floor scenarios
flags.detail: The unrated opponent is set to the lowest published Valve VRS points. These are directional sensitivity scenarios, not bookmaker probabilities.

flags.title: Current automated HLTV verification was blocked
flags.detail: HLTV returned HTTP 403 at capture; no current numeric HLTV claim is inferred.

flags.title: HotSpawn lobby response was cached
flags.detail: The fixture observation was 70.0 seconds old but within the collector's 4-hour gate.
